proposition: Around 825/1422 Isfahan enemies, jealous of his growing fame, went to Shāhrukh's court at Herat and accused him of deviating from the Sunna through a bias toward Sufism (ṣūfīgarī).

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I (829/1426), addressed to Shāhrukh
mediation.note: he describes the accusers as connivers; the motives are his own attribution
